pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with blurred edge gradients and moderate-to-low contrast. Spatial area of patches is greatest on the central flank, transitioning to smaller, more rounded geometries on the posterior and ventral aspects.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-tan pathways forming a continuous topological grid. Junction nodes are visible where three to four pathways converge. Corridor thickness is variable, narrowing toward the anterior neck and posterior hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the superior neck line, exhibiting low-amplitude tufted hair projections against the blurred background.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark-plumaged avian organism (oxpecker) is perched on the lower anterior neck region, creating a distinct visual break in the pelage pattern.
